record.one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Campaign Manager) lets businesses run paid campaigns targeting professionals, and the Marketing API lets integrations manage campaigns, creatives, reporting, leads, audiences and conversions.
record.auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow only; the docs state client credentials (2-legged) is not available for marketing use cases. Access tokens last 60 days and the member must re-authorize to refresh. Programmatic refresh tokens are limited to a set of partners. The Developer Portal has a manual token generator for testing. Scopes include r_ads, rw_ads and r_ads_reporting. The member must also hold an ad account role such as CAMPAIGN_MANAGER.
record.access_notes: Create a developer app, then apply for the Advertising API product, which has no stated fee. Every app starts in the Development tier: unlimited reads, edits on up to 5 ad accounts, and 1 test ad account created via the API. Standard tier (unlimited edits and account creation) needs a support ticket, and LinkedIn may decline it at its discretion. Audience Insights and Media Planning are restricted, and Company Intelligence is closed to new applications. I did not fetch the quick-start page, so the Development tier approval timeline and criteria are not verified.
record.blocker: Access needs LinkedIn approval for the Advertising API. Writes are capped at 5 ad accounts until a Standard tier upgrade, which LinkedIn can decline. OAuth is member-consent only, with 60-day tokens and no client-credentials flow, so end users must re-authorize periodically. Versioned APIs are sunset on a rolling basis.
